mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 61 degrees under overcast skies near Verona Community Park, with a Waxing Crescent moon phase tonight.

The City of Verona has added two new polling locations to better serve voters. Residents are encouraged to visit the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their current ward and polling location before election day.

There is a great lineup of events in Verona! You can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today, join trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory today, or look ahead to tomorrow for trivia at Hop Haus or art events at the ART House.
In our weekly police update, on October 5, officers were dispatched to a single-vehicle motorcycle crash on US Highway 18-151, resulting in medical transport for a 19-year-old Verona man.
It is a delicious day for a treat at Culver's, as today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry; stop by before they close at 11 PM tonight.
